name: Trout Beat
why_it_matters: The trout-specialist restaurant attached to Pahalgam Hotel — stocks fresh rainbow and brown trout pulled from the Lidder. Tandoori, Mediterranean and grilled preparations on one menu. The reference point for trout in the Liddar Valley.
insider_tip: Order the tandoori trout and ask for the side of saffron pulao — the curry version is heavier and masks the fish. Veg combo meals exist if half your group skips fish.
signature_address: Pahalgam Hotel, Main Market, Pahalgam, Anantnag District, J&K 192126

name: Dana Pani
why_it_matters: Pahalgam's go-to pure-veg restaurant, run by a Sardar family next to Pahalgam Hotel in the main market. Punjabi staples done well, Jain meals available on request — an outlier in a town built around mutton and trout.
insider_tip: If you're travelling with a Jain or Gujarati group, this is the only dependable address in town — order ahead during Yatra season because the line wraps around the corner.
signature_address: Main Market, near Pahalgam Hotel, Pahalgam, Anantnag District, J&K 192126

name: Cafe Log Inn
why_it_matters: Wood-cabin cafe adjacent to Pahalgam Hotel — pastries, pizzas, kashmiri kehwa, and a respectable trout dish. The closest the town has to a slow-coffee, laptop-friendly stop.
insider_tip: Two servers run the floor, so afternoons after the Yatra crowd thins out are the only sane time to settle in. Walnut tart and brownies sell out by mid-evening.
signature_address: Main Market, adjacent to Pahalgam Hotel, Pahalgam, Anantnag District, J&K 192126

name: Food Point
why_it_matters: Sheeraz Ahmad's wazwan-focused canteen on the main market strip — TripAdvisor's #10 ranking comes off consistent rogan josh and waza chicken at non-tourist prices. Open later than most kitchens in town.
insider_tip: Skip the multi-cuisine pages of the menu and order off the wazwan side — the rogan josh and waza chicken are why locals eat here, not the chowmein.
signature_address: Main Market, Pahalgam, Anantnag District, J&K 192126

name: Hotel Paradise & Restaurant
why_it_matters: Two-sided restaurant in the main market — one façade onto the bazaar, the other onto the mountain. Best known for a wazwan thali that includes gushtaba, rista, dum aloo and rogan josh in one sitting.
insider_tip: The wazwan thali is shareable for two; ordering individual portions inflates the bill quickly. Ask for the mountain-facing window seats upstairs.
signature_address: Main Market, Pahalgam, Anantnag District, J&K 192126

name: Royal Mughal Darbar
why_it_matters: Mughlai-leaning restaurant on the main market — the wazwan thali (rogan josh, goshtaba, yakhni, rista, tabak maaz) lands at around ₹1,400 for two with kebabs to start. Reviews are inconsistent; come for the thali, not à la carte.
insider_tip: Order the wazwan platter rather than ordering courses individually. Skip the chinese pages of the menu — execution drops sharply outside the kashmiri section.
signature_address: Main Market, Pahalgam, Anantnag District, J&K 192126

name: Nathu's Rasoi
why_it_matters: Franchise outpost of Delhi's Nathu's Sweets (W S Xpress Foods) — pure-veg North Indian thalis, sweets and snacks for travellers from the Hindi belt who want something familiar after a week of wazwan.
insider_tip: Stick to the snacks menu — samosas, chole bhature, sweets — rather than ordering the full thali, which is execution-shaky away from the main Delhi kitchens.
signature_address: Main Market, Pahalgam, Anantnag District, J&K 192126

name: Friends Restaurant
why_it_matters: Roadside restaurant on Chandanwari Road in Laripora — useful pit-stop on the way back from Aru or Chandanwari before re-entering town. Kashmiri staples at non-main-market pricing.
insider_tip: Open from 11am — earlier than most main-market kitchens. If you're driving back from Chandanwari mid-morning, this is the closest sit-down option before town.
signature_address: Chandanwari Road, Laripora, Pahalgam, Anantnag District, J&K 192126

name: Welcomcafe Lolaab
why_it_matters: Anchor restaurant of ITC's 5-star Welcomhotel Pine N Peak (formerly Senator Pine N Peak), perched on Rajwas Plateau. Kashmiri dishes built off family recipes — pan-Indian, oriental and continental on the same menu, all of it executed with ITC's standards.
insider_tip: Ask for the kashmiri tasting platter rather than ordering wazwan dishes individually — kitchen plates a curated set with haakh and pulao on the side. Saahil tea lounge does kahwa and pastries through the afternoon.
signature_address: Welcomhotel by ITC Hotels, Pine N Peak, Rajwas Plateau, Pahalgam, Anantnag District, J&K 192126

name: Dilkusha (Hotel Heevan Pahalgam)
why_it_matters: Hotel Heevan's main fine-dining restaurant on the Lidder's right bank. Kashmiri specialities sit alongside continental and Asian dishes — the river-view setting is the draw, and the kahwa from the Abshaar coffee shop downstairs holds up to the better cafes in town.
insider_tip: Walk-ins are allowed if you're not staying at the hotel — call ahead during peak Yatra season. Request a table on the river-facing side, not the inner banquet hall.
signature_address: Hotel Heevan Pahalgam, Aru Road, Pahalgam, Anantnag District, J&K 192126

name: Pahalgam Hotel — Main Dining Hall
why_it_matters: Main dining hall of Pahalgam Hotel (1931) — the town's oldest hospitality property. Multi-cuisine menu with explicit Gujarati and Jain sections (rare for the valley), wazwan as the signature line. Located inside the same heritage compound that houses Trout Beat and Cafe Log Inn.
insider_tip: Order the kashmiri wazwan rather than the multi-cuisine pages — the kitchen has been doing rogan josh and gushtaba for nearly a century. Picnic lunches by the Lidder can be arranged through the hotel concierge.
signature_address: Pahalgam Hotel, Main Market, Pahalgam, Anantnag District, J&K 192126
